description: Away from shining citadels and opulent palaces, reticent yakshas shelter Tian Xia’s rural hinterlands from natural disasters and otherworldly depredations.

features.name: Guardian Spirit
features.tldr: Your spiritual resilience shields you and your allies from harmful forces.

features.name: Ancestry Heritage
features.tldr: Choose a yaksha heritage representing your elemental or regional guardianship.
